verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents automatic shutdown of idle instances (zero idle cost), which covers the idle-compute half of the story. Its per-user Ducklings are pinned to fixed instance sizes and billed by the second, and usage can be reviewed through SQL views and a billing dashboard. Missing for 10: budgets or spend caps, resource monitors that act on usage, query timeouts or kill rules for runaway queries, and independent corroboration of the auto-shutdown behavior.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, budgets, resource monitors, or auto-suspend stop a runaway query or idle compute from burning money overnight

citations.quote: idle instances shut down automatically (zero idle cost)
MotherDuck provides SQL views and a billing dashboard to help you understand your compute and storage consumption.
